chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said — and those (rulers) were mentioned in his presence along with the bad condition of the Shia under them —

So he said: 'I traveled with Abu Ja'far al-Mansur while he was in his royal procession, mounted on a horse with cavalry before him and cavalry behind him, while I was on a donkey at his side. He said to me: "O Abu Abdillah, it was (the case), and it is appropriate that you rejoice in what God has given us of power and opened for us of glory, and that you not inform the people that you and your Ahl al-Bayt are more deserving of this authority than us, so as to incite us against you and against them." He said: So I said, "Whoever has conveyed this to you from me has lied." He said to me: "Do you swear by what you say?" He said: So I said, "Indeed, people are like sorcerers — meaning they like to corrupt your heart against me, so do not give them access to your hearing. For we are more in need of you than you are of us." He said to me: "Do you remember the day you were asked whether we would have a kingdom, and you said: 'Yes, long, wide, and strong; and you will continue to have respite in your affair and comfort in your worldly life until you spill from us forbidden blood in a forbidden month in a forbidden city.'" I recognized that he had memorized the hadith. So I said: "Perhaps God (Mighty and Majestic) will spare you. For I did not single you out with this —"

— and it is merely a hadith I narrated. Then perhaps another from your household will be the one to do that. So he fell silent regarding me. When I returned to my residence, one of our followers came to me and said: 'May I be your ransom! By God, I saw you in Abu Ja'far's procession while you were on a donkey and he was on a horse, and he was looking down at you speaking to you as if you were beneath him. So I said to myself: This one is God's Proof upon creation and the master of this affair whom people follow, while that other one acts with injustice, kills the children of prophets, and sheds blood in the earth with what God does not love — and he is in his procession while you are on a donkey. So doubt entered me from that until I feared for my religion and myself.' He said: So I said: 'Had you seen those who were around me and before me and behind me and to my right and to my left from among the angels, you would have considered him contemptible and considered contemptible what he is in.' So he said: 'Now my heart has settled.' Then he said: 'Until when will these (tyrants) rule, or when will there be relief from them?' So I said: 'Do you not know that everything has a duration?' He said: 'Yes.' So I said: 'Will your knowing that this affair, when it comes, will be faster than the blink of an eye — benefit you? If you were to know their state with God (Mighty and Majestic) and how it is, you would hate them more intensely. And even if you strove, or all the people of the earth strove, to plunge them into the most severe state of sin they are in, they would not be able.'

has encompassed the lands, and you see the Quran has grown worn and old, and innovations have been introduced into it and it has been directed according to desires, and you see that religion has tipped over just as water tips over, and you see the people of falsehood have risen above the people of truth, and you see evil openly displayed with none forbidding it and its people excused, and you see immorality openly manifest with men satisfied with men and women with women, and you see the believer silent with his speech not accepted, and you see the immoral person lying without his lie and slander being refuted, and you see the young disrespecting the old, and you see family ties cut, and you see the one who boasts of immorality being laughed at and his speech not refuted, and you see the young boy giving what a woman gives, and you see women marrying women, and you see flattery has proliferated, and you see the man spending wealth in disobedience to God without being stopped or restrained, and you see the observer seeking refuge with God from what he sees the believer striving in, and you see the neighbor harming his neighbor with none to prevent him, and you see the disbeliever joyful at what he sees in the believer and gleeful at the corruption he sees on the earth, and you see wine drunk openly with those who do not fear God gathering over it, and you see the one commanding good humiliated, and you see the immoral person strong and praised in what God does not love, and you see the people of signs despised and those who love them despised, and you see the path of good cut off and the path of evil traversed, and you see the House of God abandoned

and commanded to be left, and you see the man say what he does not do, and you see men beautifying themselves for men and women for women, and you see the man whose livelihood comes from his backside and the woman whose livelihood comes from her private parts, and you see women taking up gatherings as men do, and you see effeminacy appearing among the children of al-Abbas openly displaying dyeing and combing as a woman combs for her husband, and they gave wealth to men for their private parts — men competing over a man and being jealous over him, and the wealthy being more honored than the believer, and usury openly practiced without censure, and women being praised for adultery, and you see the woman bribing her husband to marry men, and you see most people and the best of households being those who assist women in their immorality, and you see the believer grieved, despised, and humiliated, and you see innovations and adultery openly manifest, and you see people relying on false witnesses, and you see the forbidden made permissible and the permissible made forbidden, and you see religion based on personal opinion with the Book and its rulings abandoned, and you see the night offering no concealment from boldness against God, and you see the believer unable to denounce except in his heart, and you see great wealth spent in God's displeasure, and you see rulers bringing the people of disbelief close and distancing the people of good, and you see rulers accepting bribes in judgment, and you see governorship auctioned to the highest bidder, and you see women of close blood relations married and sufficed with, and you see a man killed on mere accusation and suspicion, and competing over a male man who gives himself and his wealth for it, and you see the man reproached for approaching women, and you see the man eating from his wife's earnings from immorality knowing it and persisting in it, and you see

the woman dominating her husband and doing what he does not desire and spending on her husband, and you see the man renting out his wife and slave-girl and accepting the lowest of food and drink, and you see false oaths by God widespread, and you see gambling openly manifest, and you see drink sold openly with none preventing it, and you see women giving themselves to people of disbelief, and you see entertainments openly displayed with people passing by without anyone preventing them and no one dares to prevent them, and you see the noble person humiliated by the one whose authority is feared, and you see those closest to the rulers are those who praise themselves by reviling us the Ahl al-Bayt, and you see those who love us falsely accused and their testimony not accepted, and you see false speech competed over, and you see the Quran heavy on people's ears to hear and light on people's ears to hear falsehood, and you see the neighbor honoring his neighbor out of fear of his tongue, and you see the prescribed punishments abandoned and caprice practiced in them, and you see mosques adorned, and you see the most truthful person among the people being the fabricator of lies, and you see evil openly manifest and striving with tale-bearing, and you see transgression spread, and you see backbiting considered pleasing with people congratulating each other over it, and you see hajj and jihad sought for other than God, and you see the ruler humiliating the believer before the disbeliever, and you see ruin prevailing over civilization, and you see the man's livelihood from short-measuring and short-weighing, and you see bloodshed taken lightly, and you see the man seeking leadership for worldly gain and making himself notorious through foul speech so he may be feared and affairs delegated to him, and you see salat treated with contempt, and you see the man with much wealth who has not paid zakat on it

since he owned it, and you see the dead exhumed from their graves, harmed, and their burial shrouds sold, and you see killing has increased, and you see the man retiring drunk at evening and waking drunk at morning without concern for what people are in, and you see animals copulated with, and you see animals tearing each other apart, and you see the man going out to his prayer place and returning with none of his garments upon him, and you see people's hearts hardened and their eyes dried and dhikr heavy upon them, and you see unlawful gain openly displayed and competed over, and you see the one who prays only praying to be seen by people, and you see the jurist seeking jurisprudence for other than religion seeking worldly life and leadership, and you see people following whoever prevails, and you see the seeker of the permissible criticized and reproached while the seeker of the forbidden is praised and glorified, and you see the two sacred sanctuaries with what God does not love being done in them with none preventing them and no one standing between them and ugly deeds, and you see musical instruments openly displayed in the two sanctuaries, and you see the man speaking some truth, commanding good, and forbidding evil, whereupon someone rises up to advise him privately saying, 'This obligation is lifted from you,' and you see people looking at one another and following the people of evil, and you see the path of good and its way empty with none traveling it, and you see the dead mocked at with no one alarmed for him, and you see every year more evil and innovation than the year before, and you see the creation and gatherings following only the wealthy, and you see the needy given something to be laughed at and shown mercy for other than God's sake, and you see signs in the sky with none alarmed by them, and you see people copulating as animals copulate with not

No one denounces a wrong out of fear of the people; and you see a man spending much in disobedience to God while withholding even a little in obedience to God; and you see filial impiety spread openly, parents treated with disrespect and considered the worst of people by their own children, while the child rejoices at their anger; and you see women dominating the sovereignty, seizing control of every affair so that nothing happens except what they wish; and you see a man's son slandering his own father, cursing his parents, and rejoicing at their death; and you see a man who, if a day passes without him committing a grave sin—whether immorality, cheating in measures or weights, fraud, or drinking an intoxicant—goes about dejected and sad, thinking his day was wasted; and you see the ruler hoarding food; and you see the wealth of blood-relatives divided through lies, gambled with, and used to purchase wine; and you see wine being used as medicine, prescribed for the sick, and sought as a cure; and you see people having abandoned commanding good and forbidding evil, abandoning it so completely that the obligation has been lifted from them; and you see the violent winds ignored; and you see the immoral exalted because people are in need of them; and you see a man outside obedience being heeded, feared, and avoided; and you see those who pray having their prayers cut off; and you see whoever devours orphans' wealth being praised; and you see judges ruling contrary to what God commanded; and you see rulers trusting liars; and you see the inheritance being given by rulers to the people of immorality and audacity against God, taken from it and left to them; and you see the sacred law sold through bribes; and you see blood money collected, then divided without being used for righteous ends; and you see mosques adorned with gold and silver, with praises inscribed in them; and you see people's trusts treated so lightly that trust has become a spoil and treachery a matter of pride; and you see prayer belittled so much that a man fails to pray at its proper time; and you see a Muslim woman treated with the same disrespect as one would treat a slave-girl; and you see alms not given except through intercession.

Alms are not given except through intercession; and you see people seeking wealth through adultery; and you see people considering the maintenance of family ties a charity bestowed upon them; and you see the prince criticizing his followers for prayer; and you see grants given in other than their rightful place; and you see those who professed to renounce worldly life approaching rulers out of greed; and you see the companions of the Messenger of God—peace and blessings upon him and his family—reviled and insulted while no one prevents this; and you see a man who loves his companion for [the companion's] lying; and you see all the gates of good closed and all the gates of evil wide open; and you see a man who fears God and is pious finding no one to help him in that; and you see doubts spread openly; and you see the lover of worldly life desiring a long life; and you see alms distributed only through intercession; and you see a man sharing in injustice with the people lest what he has in hand be taken; and you see prayer belittled; and you see a man who has much wealth but does not pay zakat on it, and every time someone walks with him, he struts more; and you see sacrificial animals slaughtered for other than God; and you see when a man commands what is good he is mocked, and when he forbids evil he is rebuffed. And what are you going to do, O Humran? So fear God and do not be of those who follow the leaders of misguidance, and do not be of those who incline toward them in a way that will harm you on the Day of Resurrection. And know, O Humran, that if you had lived in those times while upon the same righteous deeds you are upon today, and had kept yourself free of their audacity against God the Mighty and Majestic, know that God does not waste the reward of those who do good, and that God's mercy is near to those who do good.

key_terms.آخِر الزَّمَان: the end of times / the Last Era

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the end times according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq recounts his journey with the Abbasid caliph al-Mansur and his companion Humran, then delivers an extensive prophecy of the signs of the end times: widespread injustice, moral decay, abandonment of the Quran, violations of sacred law, and the obliteration of commanding good and forbidding evil. He concludes by urging Humran to maintain taqwa and righteous deeds.

en.hubeali: H 14455 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from one of his companions, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr altogether, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Humran who said: ‘Abu Abdullahasws said, and those in hisasws presence mention the bad condition of the Shiites in hisasws presence –

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> was walking with Abu Ja’far Al-Mansour, and he was in his procession, and he was upon a horse and in front him were horsemen and behind him were horsemen, and I<sup>asws</sup> was upon a mule by his side. He said to me, ‘O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, it is befitting for you<sup>asws</sup> to be happy with what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Given us from the strength and the victory for us, and the honour, and do not tell your people that you<sup>asws</sup> and the People<sup>asws</sup> of your<sup>asws</sup> Household are more deserving of this Command (Caliphate) than we are, lest you<sup>asws</sup> provoke us against you<sup>asws</sup> and them. 
He<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘I<sup>asws</sup> replied: ‘And the one who has related this to you from me<sup>asws</sup> has lied’. He said to me<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Will you<sup>asws</sup> swear an oath on what you<sup>asws</sup> are saying?’ I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The people are magicians, meaning they would love to spoil me<sup>asws</sup> (my<sup>asw</sup><sup>s</sup> position) in front of you. So do not listen to them, for people are more in need of you than you are of us’. He said to me<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Do you<sup>asws</sup> remember the day when I asked you<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is there a kingdom for us?’, and you<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘Yes, very lengthy and vast’, you will not cease to be in the time in your command and the space in your world until you will harm us<sup>asws</sup> by shedding sacred blood in a sacred Month, in a sacred city?’ So I<sup>asws</sup> understood that he has memorized the Hadeeth. So I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Perhaps Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic will Suffice for you, for I<sup>asws</sup> did not apply this especially for you, but rather this is a Hadeeth which I<sup>asws</sup> reported to you. Maybe it is for someone else from the people of your household who will govern that’. He was silent from me<sup>asws</sup>.

When I<sup>asws</sup> returned to my<sup>asws</sup> home, one of our<sup>asws</sup> friends came up. He said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>. By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I saw you<sup>asws</sup> in the procession of Abu Ja’far (Al-Mansour) and you<sup>asws</sup> were upon a mule and he was upon a horse, and he was speaking to you like an overseer speaks to an underling. So I said to myself, ‘This is the Proof<sup>asws</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon the creatures and the Master<sup>asws</sup> of this command (Caliphate) who should be followed, and this other one is acting by compulsion, and he kills the children of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and sheds the blood in the earth by what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> does not Like, and he is in his procession, and you<sup>asws</sup> are upon a mule’, so that entered a doubt in me to the extent that I feared for my Religion and myself’. 
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Had you seen those who were around me<sup>asws</sup>, and in front of me<sup>asws</sup>, and behind me<sup>asws</sup>, and on my<sup>asws</sup> right, and on my<sup>asws</sup> left from the Angels, you would have despised him and despised what he was indulging in’. He said, ‘Now my heart is tranquil’.
Then he said, ‘Until when will these be ruling (us), or until when will we get rest from them (their injustices)?’ I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do you not know that there is a time allocated for everything?’ He said, ‘Yes’. So I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Would it benefit you if you come to know that this command (Caliphate), when it goes, it would be quicker than the blink of an eye? If you come to know their condition in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and how it would be, you would have been intense in your hatred of them. And if you were to struggle, and the people of the earth were to struggle to include them in more severity than what they are already in from the sins, you would not be able to. So do not let Satan<sup>la</sup> excite you.

The Honour is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and for His<sup>azwj</sup> Messenger<sup>saww</sup>, and for the Believers, but the hypocrites do not know. Nay! The one who waits for our<sup>asws</sup> Command, and observes patient upon what he see from the sufferings and the fear, tomorrow he would be in our<sup>asws</sup> group. So if you were to see that the truth has died and its people have gone away, and you will see, that the injustice has encompassed the country, and you will see that for the Quran they are inventing new things which are not in it and giving it a perspective in accordance to their own whims, and you will see that the Religion has receded like the receding of the water,
and you will see the people of the falsehood to have achieved high positions above the people of the truth, and you will see the evil having been manifested with no one preventing it and actually finding excuses for its committers, and you will see the mischief having appeared, and the males satisfying themselves with the males, and the women satisfying themselves with the females, and you will see the Believer maintaining silence with no one accepting his words, and you will see the mischievous lying and no one refuting his lies and his falsity, and you will see the young ones belittling the grownups, and you will see the relatives with their relationships being cut-off, and you will see the one who is praised for his mischief and he laughs at it and his words are not being refuted,

and you will see the young boy being obedient as the women are, and will see the women getting married to women, and you will see the praises being increased, and you will see the man spending the wealth in ways other than in obedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with no one preventing him or holding back his hand, and you will see the onlookers seeking Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from what they see the (situation of the) Believers are in from the struggling, and you will see the neighbour hurt his neighbour and there is no one to prevent him, and you will see the infidel rejoicing at what they see in the Believer to be in, becoming happier at what he sees in the earth from the mischief, and you will see the intoxicants being drunk openly and the ones who do not fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic gathering for it, 
and you will see the enjoining of the good being disgraced, and you will see the mischievous one indulging in what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> does not Like and being magnified and praised for it, and you will see the Masters<sup>asws</sup> of the Signs being belittled along with those who love them<sup>asws</sup>, and you will see the way of the good being cut-off and the way of the evil being travelled upon, and you will see the House of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> being blocked and orders issued for abandoning it, and you will see the man saying what he does not do, and you will see the men lustfule to the men and the women to the women, and you will see the man earning a living from his behind and the woman from her genitals, and you will see the women taking to the gatherings like the gatherings of the men,

and you will see the femininity appearing in the children of Al-Abbas and their usage of dyes and combs like the usage of these by the woman for her husband, and the men giving wealth for their genitals, and the man competing for the man and envying him, and the wealthy would be considered more honourable than the Believer, and the usury becoming publicised and he does not care, and the women being praise for their adultery, and you will see the woman preparing her husband to be married to the men, and you will see most of the people and the best of the households helping the women on their mischief,
and you will see the Believer in grief, belittled, humiliated, and you will see the innovations and the adultery becoming apparent, and you will see the people arguing by false testimonies, and you will see the Prohibited being made to be permissible and the Permissible being made to be prohibited, and you will see the Religion being taken by the opinion and the Book and its Regulations being neglected, and you will see the night not being taken as a cover for one to be audacious against Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and you will see the Believer not being able to deny except by his heart, and you will see a great amount of wealth being spent in ways which arouse the Anger of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and you will see the rulers going closer to the people of disbelief and distancing themselves from the people of the good, and you will see the rulers accepting bribes for the Judgements, and you will see the rulers welcoming the one who gives more,

and you will see the (forbidden) near relatives being married (incest) and being satisfied by it, and you will see the man killing another one based upon false accusation and upon conjecture, and differing with the man who sacrifices his self and his wealth, and you will see the man living upon the gifts of the women, and you will see the man knowingly eating from the immoral earnings of his woman and lives by it, and you will see the woman overpowering her husband and doing what he does not like and spend on her husband, and you will see the man hiring out his woman and his slave girl and is pleased with the lowest of the food and the drink, and you will see a lot of the faith in Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic by the false pretence, and you will see the gambling becoming apparent, 
and you will see the intoxicating drinks being sold openly and there is no one to prevent it, and you will see the women giving themselves to the people of disbelief, and you will see the amusement clubs having appeared and the passer by does not prevent anyone nor does anyone having the guts to prevent it, and you will see the honourable one being humbled before the one whose authority they fear, and you will see the one who loves us<sup>asws</sup> being falsified and his testimony not being accepted, and you will see the false words being competed for, and you will see the Quran has become heavy upon the people to listen to it and the people find it easier to listen to the falsehood,

and you will see the neighbour respecting the neighbour out of fear from his tongue, and you will see the Limits (Penalties of the Law) being neglected and being used in accordance with whims, and you will see the Masjids having been decorated, and you will see the most truthful one among the people to be the one who is a fabricator of the lies, and you will see the evil to have appeared and the pursuit of gossip, and you will see the transgression to be widespread, and you will see backbiting to be liked and some people giving glad tidings by it to the others, and you will see the seeking of the Pilgrimage and the Jihaad for other than Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and you will see the Sultan humiliating the Believer for the sake of the infidel, you will see the demolition to be more than the construction, and you will see the man making a living out of under-estimation of the weights and measures (cheating by measuring less), 
and you will see the shedding of the blood being taken lightly, and you will see the man seeking the leadership for coveting the world and to make himself famous by bad mouthing so that he would be feared and the matters would depend upon him, and you will see the Prayer being taken lightly, and you will see the man who has a lot of wealth then not purifying it (Zakaat) since he acquired it, and you will see the dead being exhumed from his grave, hurt and his shroud being sold, and you will see that the anarchy to have increased, and you will see the man jubilant and in the morning intoxicated not caring about what the people think of him, and you will see the animals being married to him, and you will see the animals ride upon each other,

and you will see the man come out to his Prayer place and return and there would be no signs of any gains upon him, and you will see the hearts of the people to have become hard and their eyes frozen, and the Remembrance to have become heavy upon them, and you will see the illegal money to be apparent and contested for, and you will see the Praying one who is Praying just to be seen by the people, and you will see the Faqih gaining understanding for other than Religion, to covet the world and the leadership, and you will see the people to be with the one who overcomes, you will see the seeking of the lawful to be condemned and reproached and the seeking of the unlawful to be praised and magnified, and you will see in two Sacred Places (Al-Haramain) acts being committed which Allahazwj does not Like with no hindrance preventing these and no one coming in between these and the ugly acts, and you will see the musical instruments appear in the two Sacred Places (Al-Haramain), And you will see the man speak about something from the truth and enjoin the doing of the good and prohibit from the evil, so the one being advised would stand up to him and say, ‘this is not your subject (responsibility), and you will see the people looking towards each other and follow the people of the evil, and you will see the path of the good and its way to be empty, no one travelling over it, and you will see the dead being mocked at and no one scared of it, and you will see every year new evil things and the innovations more than before, and you will see the people and the gatherings not following anyone except the rich, and you will see the needy been given so that they would be laughed at due to it, and being sympathised for other than the sake of Allahazwj, you will see signs appearing in the sky and no one fearing it, and you will see the people copulating like the copulation of the animals, with no one expressing abhorrence out of fear from the people, and you will see the man spending a great deal in ways other than the obedience to Allahazwj and being prevented easily (to spend) in the obedience to Allahazwj, and you will see the impiousness to have appeared and the belittling of the parents, and be in the most evil of the condition of the people with the children who will be happy with the one who throws accusations at them, and you will see the people, and you will see the women to have overcome upon the kingdom and to have overcome over all the commands brought about only due to the desire for them, and you will see the son of the man accusing against his father and making claims against his parent and being happy at their death, and you will see the man who passes a day in which he did not commit any great sins from the immoralities, or the understating of the weights or the measures, or unlawful acts, or drinking intoxicating drinks, he would become depressed and sad to have wasted that day from his life, and you will see the Sultan hoarding foodstuffs, and you will see the wealth of the near relatives being distributed in the false ways, and to be gambled with, and to be drunk by it the intoxicating drinks, and you will see the intoxication being utilised as medication and being prescribed to the sick to be cured by it. and you will see the people to have equalized regarding the avoidance of the enjoining of the good and the forbidding of the evil and the avoidance of the making of the Religion by it, and you will see the words of the hypocrites and the people of the hypocrisy being maintained and the words of the people of the truth wasted unnoticed, and you will see the Call to Prayer (Azaan) being given for the payment and the Prayer for the payment, and you will see the Masjids being filled from those who do not fear Allahazwj, gathering therein for the backbiting and eating of the flesh of the people of the truth and the intoxicating drinks would be described therein, and you will see the intoxicated ones Praying with (leading) the people having no understanding and will not be stained due to his intoxication, and when he is intoxicated he is respected and feared, and feared to be ignored, not being punished and being excused for his intoxicated state, and you will see the one who eats the wealth of the orphans being praised for his righteousness, and you will see the judges issuing Judgements in opposition to what Allahazwj has Ordered, and you will see the rulers entrusting to the treacherous for the greed, and you will see the rulers to have placed the inheritance to the people of the mischief and those audacious against Allahazwj, taking from them and leaving with them what they desire, and you will see upon the Pulpits preachers preaching the piety but the speaker does not practice what he has preached, and you will see the Prayer to have been taken lightly at its prescribed times, and you will see the charity given by intercession not intending by it the Perspective of Allahazwj and being given for seeking the (good will of) people, and you will see the people to be mainly concerned with their stomachs and their genitals, not caring what they eat and who they have relationship with, and you will see the world welcoming them, and you will see the banners of the truth to be a lesson for the one who is cautious and seeks salvation with Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, and know that the people are subject to the Wrath of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, but rather Heazwj has Given them respite of life which Heazwj Wants to Give them. So become expectant and spare no effort for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic to See you to be against what they are indulging in. If the Punishment descends upon them and you were to be among them, you can hasten to the Mercy of Allahazwj. If you were to hesitate you will be involved in it, and you should have come out from what they are indulged in from the audacities against Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic. And know, that Allahazwj does not Waste the Recompense of the good doers, and that the Mercy of Allahazwj is very Near to those who do good’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from one of his companions, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr altogether, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Humran who said: ‘Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said, and those in his (a.s.) presence mention the bad condition of the Shiites in his (a.s.) presence

– So he (a.s.) said: ‘I (a.s.) was walking with Abu Ja’far Al-Mansour, and he was in his procession, and he was upon a horse and in front him were horsemen and behind him were horsemen, and I (a.s.) was upon a mule by his side. He said to me, ‘O Abu Abdullah (a.s.), it is befitting for you (a.s.) to be happy with what Allah (azwj) has Given us from the strength and the victory for us, and the honour, and do not tell your people that you (a.s.) and the People (a.s.) of your (a.s.) Household are more deserving of this Command (Caliphate) than we are, lest you (a.s.) provoke us against you (a.s.) and them. He (a.s.) said, ‘I (a.s.) replied: ‘And the one who has related this to you from me (a.s.) has lied’. He said to me (a.s.), ‘Will you (a.s.) swear an oath on what you (a.s.) are saying?’ I (a.s.) said: ‘The people are magicians, meaning they would love to spoil me (a.s.) (my (a.s.) position) in front of you. So do not listen to them, for people are more in need of you than you are of us’. He said to me (a.s.), ‘Do you (a.s.) remember the day when I asked you (a.s.), ‘Is there a kingdom for us?’, and you (a.s.) said, ‘Yes, very lengthy and vast’, you will not cease to be in the time in your command and the space in your world until you will harm us (a.s.) by shedding sacred blood in a sacred Month, in a sacred city?’ So I (a.s.) understood that he has memorized the Hadeeth. So I (a.s.) said: ‘Perhaps Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic will Suffice for you, for I (a.s.) did not apply this especially for you, but rather this is a Hadeeth which I (a.s.) reported to you. Maybe it is for someone else from the people of your household who will govern that’. He was silent from me (a.s.). When I (a.s.) returned to my (a.s.) home, one of our (a.s.) friends came up. He said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.). By Allah (azwj), I saw you (a.s.) in the procession of Abu Ja’far (Al-Mansour) and you (a.s.) were upon a mule and he was upon a horse, and he was speaking to you like an overseer speaks to an underling. So I said to myself, ‘This is the Proof (a.s.) of Allah (azwj) upon the creatures and the Master (a.s.) of this command (Caliphate) who should be followed, and this other one is acting by compulsion, and he kills the children of the Prophets (as), and sheds the blood in the earth by what Allah (azwj) does not Like, and he is in his procession, and you (a.s.) are upon a mule’, so that entered a doubt in me to the extent that I feared for my Religion and myself’. He (a.s.) said: ‘I (a.s.) said: ‘Had you seen those who were around me (a.s.), and in front of me (a.s.), and behind me (a.s.), and on my (a.s.) right, and on my (a.s.) left from the Angels, you would have despised him and despised what he was indulging in’. He said, ‘Now my heart is tranquil’. Then he said, ‘Until when will these be ruling (us), or until when will we get rest from them (their injustices)?’ I (a.s.) said: ‘Do you not know that there is a time allocated for everything?’ He said, ‘Yes’. So I (a.s.) said: ‘Would it benefit you if you come to know that this command (Caliphate), when it goes, it would be quicker than the blink of an eye? If you come to know their condition in the Presence of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic and how it would be, you would have been intense in your hatred of them. And if you were to struggle, and the people of the earth were to struggle to include them in more severity than what they are already in from the sins, you would not be able to. So do not let Satan (la) excite you. The Honour is for Allah (azwj) and for His (azwj) Messenger (saww), and for the Believers, but the hypocrites do not know. Nay! The one who waits for our (a.s.) Command, and observes patient upon what he see from the sufferings and the fear, tomorrow he would be in our (a.s.) group.

So if you were to see that the truth has died and its people have gone away, and you will see, that the injustice has encompassed the country, and you will see that for the Quran they are inventing new things which are not in it and giving it a perspective in accordance to their own whims, and you will see that the Religion has receded like the receding of the water, and you will see the people of the falsehood to have achieved high positions above the people of the truth, and you will see the evil having been manifested with no one preventing it and actually finding excuses for its committers, and you will see the mischief having appeared, and the males satisfying themselves with the males, and the women satisfying themselves with the females, and you will see the Believer maintaining silence with no one accepting his words, and you will see the mischievous lying and no one refuting his lies and his falsity, and you will see the young ones belittling the grownups, and you will see the relatives with their relationships being cut-off, and you will see the one who is praised for his mischief and he laughs at it and his words are not being refuted, and you will see the young boy being obedient as the women are, and will see the women getting married to women, and you will see the praises being increased, and you will see the man spending the wealth in ways other than in obedience to Allah (azwj) with no one preventing him or holding back his hand, and you will see the onlookers seeking Refuge with Allah (azwj) from what they see the (situation of the) Believers are in from the struggling, and you will see the neighbour hurt his neighbour and there is no one to prevent him, and you will see the infidel rejoicing at what they see in the Believer to be in, becoming happier at what he sees in the earth from the mischief, and you will see the intoxicants being drunk openly and the ones who do not fear Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic gathering for it, and you will see the enjoining of the good being disgraced, and you will see the mischievous one indulging in what Allah (azwj) does not Like and being magnified and praised for it, and you will see the Masters (a.s.) of the Signs being belittled along with those who love them (a.s.), and you will see the way of the good being cut-off and the way of the evil being travelled upon, and you will see the House of Allah (azwj) being blocked and orders issued for abandoning it, and you will see the man saying what he does not do, and you will see the men lustfule to the men and the women to the women, and you will see the man earning a living from his behind and the woman from her genitals, and you will see the women taking to the gatherings like the gatherings of the men, and you will see the femininity appearing in the children of Al-Abbas and their usage of dyes and combs like the usage of these by the woman for her husband, and the men giving wealth for their genitals, and the man competing for the man and envying him, and the wealthy would be considered more honourable than the Believer, and the usury becoming publicised and he does not care, and the women being praise for their adultery, and you will see the woman preparing her husband to be married to the men, and you will see most of the people and the best of the households helping the women on their mischief, and you will see the Believer in grief, belittled, humiliated, and you will see the innovations and the adultery becoming apparent, and you will see the people arguing by false testimonies, and you will see the Prohibited being made to be permissible and the Permissible being made to be prohibited, and you will see the Religion being taken by the opinion and the Book and its Regulations being neglected, and you will see the night not being taken as a cover for one to be audacious against Allah (azwj), and you will see the Believer not being able to deny except by his heart, and you will see a great amount of wealth being spent in ways which arouse the Anger of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic, and you will see the rulers going closer to the people of disbelief and distancing themselves from the people of the good, and you will see the rulers accepting bribes for the Judgements, and you will see the rulers welcoming the one who gives more, and you will see the (forbidden) near relatives being married (incest) and being satisfied by it, and you will see the man killing another one based upon false accusation and upon conjecture, and differing with the man who sacrifices his self and his wealth, and you will see the man living upon the gifts of the women, and you will see the man knowingly eating from the immoral earnings of his woman and lives by it, and you will see the woman overpowering her husband and doing what he does not like and spend on her husband, and you will see the man hiring out his woman and his slave girl and is pleased with the lowest of the food and the drink, and you will see a lot of the faith in Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic by the false pretence, and you will see the gambling becoming apparent, and you will see the intoxicating drinks being sold openly and there is no one to prevent it, and you will see the women giving themselves to the people of disbelief, and you will see the amusement clubs having appeared and the passer by does not prevent anyone nor does anyone having the guts to prevent it, and you will see the honourable one being humbled before the one whose authority they fear, and you will see the one who loves us (a.s.) being falsified and his testimony not being accepted, and you will see the false words being competed for, and you will see the Quran has become heavy upon the people to listen to it and the people find it easier to listen to the falsehood, and you will see the neighbour respecting the neighbour out of fear from his tongue, and you will see the Limits (Penalties of the Law) being neglected and being used in accordance with whims, and you will see the Masjids having been decorated, and you will see the most truthful one among the people to be the one who is a fabricator of the lies, and you will see the evil to have appeared and the pursuit of gossip, and you will see the transgression to be widespread, and you will see backbiting to be liked and some people giving glad tidings by it to the others, and you will see the seeking of the Pilgrimage and the Jihaad for other than Allah (azwj), and you will see the Sultan humiliating the Believer for the sake of the infidel, you will see the demolition to be more than the construction, and you will see the man making a living out of under-estimation of the weights and measures (cheating by measuring less), and you will see the shedding of the blood being taken lightly, and you will see the man seeking the leadership for coveting the world and to make himself famous by bad mouthing so that he would be feared and the matters would depend upon him, and you will see the Prayer being taken lightly, and you will see the man who has a lot of wealth then not purifying it (Zakaat) since he acquired it, and you will see the dead being exhumed from his grave, hurt and his shroud being sold, and you will see that the anarchy to have increased, and you will see the man jubilant and in the morning intoxicated not caring about what the people think of him, and you will see the animals being married to him, and you will see the animals ride upon each other, and you will see the man come out to his Prayer place and return and there would be no signs of any gains upon him, and you will see the hearts of the people to have become hard and their eyes frozen, and the Remembrance to have become heavy upon them, and you will see the illegal money to be apparent and contested for, and you will see the Praying one who is Praying just to be seen by the people, and you will see the Faqih gaining understanding for other than Religion, to covet the world and the leadership, and you will see the people to be with the one who overcomes, you will see the seeking of the lawful to be condemned and reproached and the seeking of the unlawful to be praised and magnified, and you will see in two Sacred Places (Al-Haramain) acts being committed which Allah (azwj) does not Like with no hindrance preventing these and no one coming in between these and the ugly acts, and you will see the musical instruments appear in the two Sacred Places (Al-Haramain), And you will see the man speak about something from the truth and enjoin the doing of the good and prohibit from the evil, so the one being advised would stand up to him and say, ‘this is not your subject (responsibility), and you will see the people looking towards each other and follow the people of the evil, and you will see the path of the good and its way to be empty, no one travelling over it, and you will see the dead being mocked at and no one scared of it, and you will see every year new evil things and the innovations more than before, and you will see the people and the gatherings not following anyone except the rich, and you will see the needy been given so that they would be laughed at due to it, and being sympathised for other than the sake of Allah (azwj), you will see signs appearing in the sky and no one fearing it, and you will see the people copulating like the copulation of the animals, with no one expressing abhorrence out of fear from the people, and you will see the man spending a great deal in ways other than the obedience to Allah (azwj) and being prevented easily (to spend) in the obedience to Allah (azwj), and you will see the impiousness to have appeared and the belittling of the parents, and be in the most evil of the condition of the people with the children who will be happy with the one who throws accusations at them, and you will see the people, and you will see the women to have overcome upon the kingdom and to have overcome over all the commands brought about only due to the desire for them, and you will see the son of the man accusing against his father and making claims against his parent and being happy at their death, and you will see the man who passes a day in which he did not commit any great sins from the immoralities, or the understating of the weights or the measures, or unlawful acts, or drinking intoxicating drinks, he would become depressed and sad to have wasted that day from his life, and you will see the Sultan hoarding foodstuffs, and you will see the wealth of the near relatives being distributed in the false ways, and to be gambled with, and to be drunk by it the intoxicating drinks, and you will see the intoxication being utilised as medication and being prescribed to the sick to be cured by it. and you will see the people to have equalized regarding the avoidance of the enjoining of the good and the forbidding of the evil and the avoidance of the making of the Religion by it, and you will see the words of the hypocrites and the people of the hypocrisy being maintained and the words of the people of the truth wasted unnoticed, and you will see the Call to Prayer (Azaan) being given for the payment and the Prayer for the payment, and you will see the Masjids being filled from those who do not fear Allah (azwj), gathering therein for the backbiting and eating of the flesh of the people of the truth and the intoxicating drinks would be described therein, and you will see the intoxicated ones Praying with (leading) the people having no understanding and will not be stained due to his intoxication, and when he is intoxicated he is respected and feared, and feared to be ignored, not being punished and being excused for his intoxicated state, and you will see the one who eats the wealth of the orphans being praised for his righteousness, and you will see the judges issuing Judgements in opposition to what Allah (azwj) has Ordered, and you will see the rulers entrusting to the treacherous for the greed, and you will see the rulers to have placed the inheritance to the people of the mischief and those audacious against Allah (azwj), taking from them and leaving with them what they desire, and you will see upon the Pulpits preachers preaching the piety but the speaker does not practice what he has preached, and you will see the Prayer to have been taken lightly at its prescribed times, and you will see the charity given by intercession not intending by it the Perspective of Allah (azwj) and being given for seeking the (good will of) people, and you will see the people to be mainly concerned with their stomachs and their genitals, not caring what they eat and who they have relationship with, and you will see the world welcoming them, and you will see the banners of the truth to be a lesson for the one who is cautious and seeks salvation with Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic, and know that the people are subject to the Wrath of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic, but rather He (azwj) has Given them respite of life which He (azwj) Wants to Give them. So become expectant and spare no effort for Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic to See you to be against what they are indulging in. If the Punishment descends upon them and you were to be among them, you can hasten to the Mercy of Allah (azwj). If you were to hesitate you will be involved in it, and you should have come out from what they are indulged in from the audacities against Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic. And know, that Allah (azwj) does not Waste the Recompense of the good doers, and that the Mercy of Allah (azwj) is very Near to those who do good’.
